title: Infrastructural power: data and code on AI systems, developers and cloud dependencies in the Danish public sector
description: Coded data, code and figures for an explorative analysis of the infrastructural dependencies that shape the implementation of AI systems across the Danish public sector: a register of AI systems (one row per system and public authority), the developers that supply them, and the cloud providers they build on. Data snapshot 23 November 2026. Free-text and personal data from the working file are not included. See README, CODEBOOK and LIMITATIONS.
